query: How many days do I have to return an item, and does the clock start at the order date?
expected_answer: 30 calendar days, counted from the delivery date recorded by the carrier, not the order date.
author: arda

query: I ran 15 km on a trail in my new shoes and they rub my heel. Can I send them back for a refund?
expected_answer: No. Shoes used outdoors cannot be refunded, even for fit or comfort problems; only a manufacturing defect is reviewed under the warranty.
author: arda

query: What happens if your warehouse sees that the shoes I sent back were worn outside?
expected_answer: They are sent back to the customer at the customer's cost and no refund is issued.
author: arda

query: I filled my soft flask with water to test the bite valve. Can I still return it because I changed my mind?
expected_answer: No. Filling a soft flask counts as use and breaks the hygiene rule, so it cannot be returned for change of mind.
author: arda

query: My GPS watch is still sealed in its box and was delivered 12 days ago. Can I return it?
expected_answer: Yes. An unopened, never-paired watch follows the standard 30-day window.
author: arda

query: What discount makes an item FINAL-SALE?
expected_answer: Clearance items with a discount above 40% are marked FINAL-SALE.
author: arda

query: A manager told me on the phone that I could return my clearance jacket after 60 days. Is that promise valid?
expected_answer: No. No staff member can make an exception for FINAL-SALE items; a phone promise does not make it returnable (a human review can be requested, but it applies the policy).
author: arda

query: How much do I pay for return shipping on my second exchange from the same order?
expected_answer: A flat 89 TRY return shipping from the second exchange on; sending the replacement stays free.
author: arda

query: The size I want to swap to is sold out. What are my options?
expected_answer: The exchange depends on stock; if the replacement is out of stock the customer can choose a refund instead. No restock dates are promised.
author: arda

query: How many days do I have to report that an item arrived damaged?
expected_answer: Within 7 days of the delivery date.
author: arda

query: If I send a photo of the damage, is my refund approved automatically?
expected_answer: No. A photo is evidence for a human reviewer, not an automatic approval.
author: arda

query: I bought the vest together with two flasks at a bundle price. Can I return just one flask?
expected_answer: Only if the remaining items are kept at their full individual price; the difference is deducted from the refund. Otherwise the bundle is returned as a whole.
author: arda

query: How long is a TrailRun TR gift card valid?
expected_answer: 12 months from the date of purchase.
author: arda

query: I paid by bank transfer. How long does the refund take to arrive after it is issued?
expected_answer: 2–5 business days, to the account that paid.
author: arda

query: Can you send my refund to my other credit card instead of the one I paid with?
expected_answer: No. Support cannot pay a refund to a different card, account or person.
author: arda

query: By what time do I need to order for same-day dispatch?
expected_answer: Before 14:00 on a business day; later orders, weekends and holidays ship the next business day.
author: arda

query: How much is standard shipping on a 1,200 TRY order?
expected_answer: 79 TRY, because the order is under the 1,500 TRY free-shipping threshold.
author: arda

query: My order already ships free. Do I still pay extra if I pick the same-day Istanbul courier?
expected_answer: Yes. The 149 TRY Express fee is charged even when the order qualifies for free standard shipping.
author: arda

query: Tracking says my parcel was delivered but nothing arrived. What should I do?
expected_answer: Report it within 48 hours; support opens a carrier investigation.
author: arda

query: My parcel got lost. Will you give me a voucher for the trouble?
expected_answer: No. Apart from the free re-shipment (or refund if out of stock), TrailRun TR pays no compensation such as vouchers or cash.
author: arda

query: My order is already on its way. Can you change the delivery address?
expected_answer: No. After dispatch TrailRun TR cannot change the address; the customer can ask the carrier to redirect the parcel to a branch using the tracking number.
author: arda

query: Do you ship to Germany?
expected_answer: No. TrailRun TR ships only to Türkiye and Northern Cyprus.
author: arda

query: Can I use two discount codes on the same order?
expected_answer: No. Only one discount code can be used per order.
author: arda

query: When does my race-bib discount code expire?
expected_answer: 30 days after the race date.
author: arda

query: Our running club wants 40 jackets. Can support give us a bulk price?
expected_answer: Bulk orders are handled by the business team; support forwards the request and does not quote bulk prices.
author: arda

query: The sole of my trail shoe came off after five months of normal running. Do I get my money back?
expected_answer: A sole separating under normal use is a manufacturing defect covered by the 2-year warranty: it is repaired or replaced, not refunded in cash.
author: arda

query: Water no longer beads on my rain jacket. Is that a warranty defect?
expected_answer: No. Loss of beading is not covered; re-apply a DWR treatment.
author: arda

query: The quicklace on my Speedcross 6 snapped after three years. Will you replace it for free?
expected_answer: No. Quicklace is replaced free only within the 2-year warranty; after 2 years replacement kits are bought separately.
author: arda

query: The battery of my Garmin started failing after three months. Who handles this?
expected_answer: After 7 days it goes under the manufacturer's 2-year warranty: TrailRun TR passes the claim to the brand's authorized service in Türkiye, and the brand decides on repair or replacement.
author: arda

query: My carbon pole snapped when I fell on a descent. Is that covered?
expected_answer: No. Breaks from a fall are not covered.
author: arda

query: What is the heel-to-toe drop of the Hoka Speedgoat 5?
expected_answer: 4 mm.
author: arda

query: I am 175 cm tall. Which length of the Leki carbon poles should I take?
expected_answer: Usually 120 cm (height × 0.68).
author: arda

query: My chest measures 99 cm. Which size of the Adv Skin 12 vest fits me?
expected_answer: Size M (94–102 cm).
author: arda

query: Siparişim 1.500 TL'nin üzerindeyse kargo ücretsiz mi?
expected_answer: Evet. 1.500 TRY ve üzeri siparişlerde standart kargo ücretsizdir.
author: arda

query: Kuzey Kıbrıs'a gönderim ne kadar sürüyor ve kargo ücreti ne kadar?
expected_answer: Aras Kargo ile 4–7 iş günü; sipariş tutarından bağımsız sabit 249 TRY. Alıcıdan yerel gümrük ücreti istenebilir.
author: arda

query: Ayakkabıları sadece evde halıda denedim, yarım numara büyük geldi. Teslim alalı 10 gün oldu, iade edebilir miyim?
expected_answer: Evet. Sadece içeride denenmiş ve 30 gün içinde olduğu için iade edilebilir (etiketleri ve kutusuyla).
author: arda

query: Kargom 4 iş günüdür hiç hareket etmedi, ne yapmalıyım?
expected_answer: 3 iş gününden uzun süre tarama yoksa destek kargo firmasına eskale eder ve takip ister; müşteriye vaka numarası verilir.
author: arda

query: Hediye kartıyla ödediğim ürünün iadesi banka hesabıma yatar mı?
expected_answer: Hayır. Hediye kartıyla ödenen ürünün iadesi yeni bir hediye kartına yapılır (aynı gün), banka hesabına değil.
author: arda

query: La Sportiva Prodigio normalden küçük mü kalıyor, hangi numarayı almalıyım?
expected_answer: Evet, yaklaşık yarım numara küçük kalır; çoğu müşteri normal numarasından yarım numara büyük alır.
author: arda

query: Kırılan BOA çarkı ücretsiz değiştiriliyor mu?
expected_answer: Evet. Kırık BOA çarkı veya kopan BOA ipi ayakkabının ömrü boyunca ücretsiz değiştirilir.
author: arda

author: dilara

author: dilara

author: dilara

query: Büyük indirimden aldığım montun bedeni olmadı, değiştirebilir miyim?
author: dilara

author: dilara

author: dilara

author: dilara

author: dilara
